note: Every entry is asserted by tools/verify.mjs and test/catalogue.mjs. The failing page trips exactly the findings listed in onFail and nothing else, and the corrected page trips no finding in the repository at all. onFail is set equality in both directions, so a detector that gains a reason to fire has to say so here.

examples.summary: Header icon buttons whose only content is a decorative glyph, so there is nothing to announce.
examples.correction: Visually hidden text inside the button, which survives translation, a failed icon set and voice control.

examples.summary: A quick add button inside the anchor that wraps the whole product card.
examples.correction: Controls as siblings, with a stretched pseudo-element on the title link keeping the card clickable for a pointer.

examples.summary: Variant swatches built from div elements with click handlers: no keyboard access, no group name, state in a border colour.
examples.correction: A fieldset and legend around native radio inputs, with the colour name as text.

examples.summary: A skip link hidden with display:none, pointing at a target that cannot take focus.
examples.correction: Offset off screen and brought back on focus, with tabindex="-1" on the target.

examples.summary: A global outline reset, added to stop the ring appearing on mouse click.
examples.correction: :focus-visible, which shows the indicator for keyboard input and suppresses it for pointers, plus a forced-colors fallback.

examples.summary: user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 on the viewport meta tag.
examples.correction: No scaling restriction, and a 16px minimum font size on fields, which is what the restriction was usually reaching for.

examples.summary: A cart drawer with no role, no aria-modal and no accessible name.
examples.correction: Dialog semantics and a name pointing at the heading already present. The behaviour half is in assets/a11y-focus-trap.js.

examples.summary: Sale and regular prices distinguished by a strikethrough and a red, with no text saying which is which.
examples.correction: Hidden labels naming each price, with no visual change.

examples.summary: The cart status region appended to the page with its message already inside it, so there is no mutation to observe.
examples.correction: One empty region in the document before the first message, written on a later frame.

examples.summary: A newsletter email field whose placeholder is doing the work of a label, with no autocomplete token.
examples.correction: A real label associated by for and id, hidden visually, plus autocomplete="email".

examples.summary: Pagination links sized 16 by 16, because the target was sized to the glyph.
examples.correction: A 24 by 24 minimum on the hit area with the digit left at its original size.
